title: Poland: At least 5 killed in shooting in Krakow, police say
summary: At least five people were killed and more than a dozen injured after a shooter opened fire in a market square in Krakow.

image.caption: An ambulance helicopter landed in the main square in Krakow after a shootingImage: Art Service/PAP/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: At least five people were killed and more than a dozen wounded in a shooting near the main market square in the southern Polish city of Krakow on Saturday.
The perpetrator has been shot and wounded by police, authorities said.
"The perpetrator was shot by police ‌officers and is currently being ‌transported ​to a hospital," police wrote on X.
What do we know about the shooting
According to Krakow police, the gunman aimed at random people as he drove by the city's Main square. Among the wounded are police officers.
Initially, the authorities urged people in the immediate vicinity to evacuate to a safe place.

blocks.caption: Police secure the area where a shooting occurredImage: Jakub Włodek/Agencja Wyborcza.pl/REUTERS

blocks.text: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk posted on X that police are investigating the attack and called shooting "tragic."
Meanwhile, Polish President Karol Nawrocki wrote on X that his thoughts were with the victims and wounded, as well as their families.
Krakow is located about 250 kilometers (155 miles) from Warsaw, the capital of Poland. It is Poland's second-largest city.
This is a developing story. Please check back for the latest version.
